D1_endpoint_dimensionality.rule: S5 yields k=3 focal atoms per document. A SECOND stage selects exactly ONE of those three as the DOCUMENT-LEVEL FOCAL ATOM. That single atom is reused across every single-focal document-level evaluation of that document.
D1_endpoint_dimensionality.amendment_note: The second stage is a prospective design amendment, not an implementation of S5. It must be recorded as such. Hajek estimation is unchanged; only the inclusion probability carries the extra factor.
D1_endpoint_dimensionality.why_once_per_document: If each unit sampled its focal atom independently, two policies evaluated on the same document at the same budget would target different atoms and the paired comparison would no longer be paired. Choosing once per document preserves pairing and commensurability across policies, comparators, sham, budgets and receivers.

steps: 1. Use frozen source text and frozen atom char_start/char_end.
2. Sentence boundary is deterministic: document edge, blank-line boundary, or '.', '?' or '!' followed by whitespace or end-of-document.
3. Select the smallest such segment containing the focal span.
4. If that segment exceeds 512 characters, fall back to exactly 160 characters left + 160 right, clipped at document boundaries.
5. Replace the exact focal span with <TARGET>.
6. Replace every remaining canonical-equivalent occurrence, located by the frozen matcher find_spans() semantics, with <EQUIV_REDACTED>.
7. Normalise CRLF and CR to LF after extraction; collapse whitespace runs to one ASCII space; strip outer whitespace.
9. On deterministic failure or residual ambiguity emit ATTRIBUTE_NOT_DETERMINISTICALLY_RESOLVABLE. Never hand-write a replacement.
D4_slot_derivation.prereg_basis: S7 requires enough identity and context to ask a well-defined question while withholding the focal value; bare slots are forbidden.

D5_s9_reserve.arm_composition_rationale: Human-truth presence requires the receiver to actually reproduce the value, which is far rarer than the presence arm itself. A presence-heavy reserve is needed to reach 100 true-presence cases. This is OPERATIONAL SIZING ONLY: the arm is a design variable, not a matcher output, and it does not enter case selection, labelling or estimation.
selection_rule: Freeze the complete ordered reserve BEFORE any annotation.
Annotate strictly in frozen reserve order.
Final audit = first 100 adjudicated human-truth presence + first 100 adjudicated human-truth absence, in that order.
Matcher predictions MUST NOT be computed or inspected until those 200 ids are permanently fixed.
Reserve exhausts before either stratum reaches 100 -> FAIL CLOSED.

tie_break_detail: 1. Two independent blinded labels per case.
2. On disagreement, BOTH humans perform a second-pass consensus adjudication, still blinded to all matcher output.
3. Consensus reached -> that label is the truth label.
4. Genuinely unresolved -> HUMAN_UNRESOLVED; the case is excluded and the next reserve case is taken.
D6_annotation.tie_break_rationale: The earlier DROP_AND_ADVANCE rule discarded every disagreement, which preferentially removes the ambiguous and hard cases and thereby makes the matcher audit easier than deployment. A blinded consensus pass retains the hard cases without making either annotator authoritative.

hard_stops: G19 MUST PASS BEFORE THE CONFIRMATORY RUN LAUNCHES. No exception, no deferral, no gate modification.
The matcher constructs the stimulus via D4 find_spans() redaction, so an uncertified matcher contaminates prompts, not merely scores.
If the matcher fails S9, repair it without reference to confirmatory outcomes and re-audit on FRESH blinded cases. Never reuse labelled cases.
If the 600-case reserve exhausts before either truth stratum reaches 100, FAIL CLOSED.
Receiver replacement is CLOSED. A further receiver failure is a scientific halt, not a substitution.
gate-r05 must PASS in full before launch.
B* must be re-verified by harness_budget_calibration.py on the two-receiver panel before freeze.

withdrawn_deviations.was: matcher certification blocks CLAIMS, not LAUNCH
withdrawn_deviations.now: matcher certification BLOCKS LAUNCH. No deferral. No gate modification.
withdrawn_deviations.why_withdrawn: D4 step 6 uses the frozen matcher find_spans() to redact canonical equivalents from the prompt, so the matcher CONSTRUCTS THE STIMULUS, not merely the score. An under-detecting matcher leaks the answer into the question and inflates recovery. If S9 later fails and the matcher is repaired, the repaired matcher can reveal that already-generated prompts were leaky; rescoring the same responses cannot repair a contaminated stimulus and the run would have to be regenerated. Separately, installed gate-r05 has no deferral mechanism: G19 FAIL means GATE=FAIL and DO NOT LAUNCH. Honouring DEV-3 would have required either ignoring the authoritative gate or editing it again.
withdrawn_deviations.cost: The blinded annotation returns to the serial critical path, roughly +8 h.

budget.method: F_ir = tokenizer_r.count(render_message(atomize(doc_i))); F* = median_r(median_i F_ir); B1=round(F*/2); B2=round(F*/1.5); B3=200
budget.independence_note: B* was recomputed from the two surviving receivers' own per-receiver median token counts, which are receiver-specific and unaffected by panel membership. Only the outer median changes. The result coincides with the historical Muse-panel value of 89; this is an independent recalculation that happens to agree, NOT a reuse of the Muse-calibrated constant.
budget.reverification_required: harness_budget_calibration.py --receivers nvidia_gpt_oss_20b nvidia_nemotron3_super_120b_a12b  (must be run on the Mac under Python 3.12; this file records the arithmetic only)
